Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We're looking for an AI Learning Experience Designer (AI-LXD) to build the next generation of enablement experiences.
In this role, you'll design AI-powered learning journeys, performance support tools, knowledge experiences, and dynamic enablement programs that help employees find information, build skills, and apply knowledge in the flow of work.

You'll partner with enablement leaders, product marketing, subject matter experts, and AI platform teams to transform complex information into personalized, scalable learning experiences. This role combines instructional design, AI-enabled content development, knowledge management, user experience design, and data-driven optimization.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Design AI-powered learning experiences that improve knowledge retention, accelerate skill development, and drive employee performance.
Design and develop personalized learning journeys that adapt to learner needs and support employees throughout their onboarding and career journeys.
Build dynamic knowledge experiences by transforming static content into searchable, AI-enabled knowledge assets.
Create learning assets across multiple formats, including e-learning modules, instructor-led training materials, videos, knowledge articles, playbooks, assessments, simulations, job aids, and interactive learning experiences.
Use AI to accelerate content development by generating, transforming, refining, and maintaining learning content at scale.
Create AI-generated simulations, practice scenarios, coaching prompts, assessments, and reinforcement activities.
Design learning experiences that support employees both during formal learning and in the flow of work.
Partner with enablement leaders, sales leaders, product marketing, enablement business partners, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and translate them into scalable learning solutions.
Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to create engaging, effective, and measurable learning experiences.
Measure learning effectiveness using learner engagement, adoption, search behavior, knowledge utilization, and business performance data.
Continuously optimize learning experiences based on analytics, user feedback, and changing business needs.
Champion and model Samsara's operating principles while contributing to a collaborative, high-performing enablement organization.

Demonstrated experience building with AI to design, develop, and scale learning experiences, including AI-assisted content creation, prompt engineering, content transformation, and workflow optimization.
5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, sales enablement, knowledge management, or a related field.
3+ years of experience designing and developing learning programs and enablement content for sales, customer success, partner, or other customer-facing organizations.
Demonstrated experience creating scalable learning experiences across multiple delivery formats, including digital, virtual, instructor-led, and in-the-flow-of-work learning.
Experience creating AI-generated learning assets, including simulations, assessments, role-play scenarios, coaching activities, and performance support resources.
Experience creating and maintaining knowledge assets, including playbooks, job aids, knowledge articles, learning pathways, and performance support resources.
Experience translating business priorities, performance gaps, and stakeholder requirements into scalable learning solutions.
Experience using learning technologies and content development tools such as Articulate, Absorb (LMS), Showpad (CMS), Jira, AI-assisted content development tools, and knowledge management systems.
Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Experience measuring learning effectiveness and using learner engagement, adoption, and business performance data to continuously improve learning experiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex concepts and transform them into engaging, actionable learning experiences.

Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced SaaS or technology company.
Familiarity with adult learning theory and instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar methodologies.
Experience designing conversational learning experiences and AI-enabled performance support solutions.
Experience with information architecture, content strategy, or knowledge management.
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Enablement teams.
Experience supporting a knowledge management ecosystem and maintaining large content repositories.
A track record of experimenting with emerging technologies and applying innovative approaches to learning design.

At Peloton, we empower people to live fit, strong, long, and happy lives and the Learning and Development team plays a pivotal role in bringing this mission to life internally. By creating learning experiences that help team members grow stronger in their roles, thrive over the long haul, and find joy in their professional journeys, we enable everyone at Peloton to bring their best and lift people up.
We are seeking a Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Development team. Someone who is a creative, detail-oriented builder who can transform complex ideas into compelling, engaging, and measurable learning experiences. They’ll be responsible for designing and developing scalable learning assets that support our management programs, onboarding suite, and skills-based learning strategy.
Reporting to the Director, Learning and Development, you will partner closely with subject matter experts, People Business Partners, and external vendors to build experiences that are not just informative, but truly transformative.
If you have a passion for learning craft, a strong visual sensibility, and the ability to work with speed and rigor in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Lead full-cycle instructional design for a variety of learning formats including eLearning modules, virtual instructor-led training (VILT), job aids, microlearning, and blended learning programs using methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, and Agile
Develop production-quality eLearning and multimedia content using Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise), Vyond, Adobe Creative Suite, Gemini, and Notebook LM
Create visually compelling supporting materials including facilitator guides, participant workbooks, slide decks, and digital job aids that reflect Peloton’s brand and voice
Partner with the Director, Learning and Development and internal subject matter experts to translate business needs and learning objectives into engaging, outcomes-driven content
Apply adult learning theory and evidence-based design principles to ensure all content is relevant, accessible, and designed for impact
Partner with the Learning Technology and Operations Specialist to ensure all content is properly uploaded, tested, and deployed in the LMS
Continuously iterate on existing content based on learner feedback, program data, and evolving business priorities
Leverage AI-based tools and emerging learning technologies to accelerate content development and enhance learner experience, helping position Peloton as a trailblazer in the L&D space
Collaborate across the Global Talent team, including Talent Management and Talent Acquisition, to develop content that supports the full employee lifecycle
Support the development of skills-based learning assets that deliver bite-sized, engaging learning in the flow of work
Participate in program evaluation efforts, analyzing learner feedback and completion data to recommend and implement content improvements
Stay current on instructional design trends, tools, and best practices, proactively sharing insights that push Peloton’s learning experiences forward

4–6 years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, or a closely related field, ideally within a corporate or high-growth environment
Working knowledge of instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, or Agile) and adult learning theory
Experience developing content for all-staff, management, and leadership programs
Experience designing for multiple modalities: eLearning, ILT, blended, microlearning, and performance support tools
Proficiency with Articulate 360 (Storyline and/or Rise) is required; experience with Vyond and Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Illustrator, or Photoshop) strongly preferred
Proven ability to manage full course development life cycles independently
Strong written communication skills and the ability to write in an authentic, on-brand voice that resonates with diverse audiences
Deep care about how learning looks and feels, not just what it says
Familiarity with LMS platforms (Seismic experience a plus) and ability to manage content deployment and maintenance
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
A collaborative, low-ego orientation that moves you to step in to support Talent team members in bringing their best and lifting people up

eLearning Developer with The Learning Network (TLN)
Build Learning Experiences That Make an Impact
Are you passionate about creating engaging, interactive learning experiences? Do you enjoy bringing learning content to life through technology, multimedia, and thoughtful design? If so, we'd love to hear from you.
TLN is seeking an eLearning Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you'll work closely with instructional designers, project managers, subject matter experts, and clients to develop high-quality digital learning solutions that help organizations achieve their learning and business objectives.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to create exceptional learning experiences.

Transform storyboards, scripts, and instructional materials into interactive digital learning experiences
Create simulations, assessments, branching scenarios, and reusable learning assets
Collaborate with instructional designers, SMEs, project managers, and clients to deliver effective learning solutions
Conduct quality assurance testing to ensure courses function correctly across devices and learning platforms
Troubleshoot LMS, SCORM, accessibility, media, and publishing issues
Apply accessibility standards and WCAG best practices where required
Incorporate feedback from user acceptance testing and stakeholders
Manage multiple projects while maintaining quality, timelines, and client expectations
Contribute to the continuous improvement of development standards, templates, and workflows
Explore emerging technologies, AI-enabled tools, and automation opportunities to improve development efficiency

Required Qualifications Experience developing eLearning using Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise)
Experience with multimedia and design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, and After Effects
Ability to build interactive and engaging learning experiences from storyboards and design specifications
Understanding of LMS environments, SCORM/xAPI standards, publishing, and tracking requirements
Knowledge of accessibility standards and quality assurance testing practices
Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, remote environment
Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience with Vyond, Adobe Captivate, or similar authoring tools
Understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
Experience creating learning simulations and scenario-based training
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and automation technologies
Experience working with enterprise clients and complex learning projects

At TLN, we're passionate about helping organizations build knowledge, skills, and capability through innovative learning solutions. You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented professionals, and contribute to learning experiences that make a real difference.

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

As an Instructional Designer , you will craft and refine impactful learning content and facilitator materials to upskill global teams across all international markets. Serving as a cornerstone for capability building, you will drive training excellence in Customer Service, Retention, Product, System, and Technical operations across the HF Brand umbrella, and contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

·
Instructional Design & Content Creation: Apply core ID frameworks (e.g., ADDIE) to build slide packs, e-learning modules, and facilitator guides for global staff.

·

·

Customer Experience Focus: Dedication to upholding high customer service standards, ensuring excellent customer interaction principles are embedded in all learning programs.

·
Agile Work Ethic: Meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and the flexibility to adapt to changing processes and meet tight deadlines.

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen ) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.
Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.
We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join our B2B Curriculum team and develop technical / AI-focused courses for corporate clients. You will turn client needs and subject-matter expertise into practical, scalable learning experiences and continuously improve them using learner feedback and expert recommendations.
This is a full-time remote contract position. After the Online Introductory Call, candidates will be required to complete a test assignment.

Own the end-to-end development of new B2B courses, from learning needs analysis and high-level design to final course documentation, in collaboration with Product Managers and subject-matter experts.
Build course Skill Trees and map learning outcomes across the course, modules, and individual lessons.
Create educational content, practice exercises, assessments, and learning aids based on materials provided by subject-matter experts.
Prepare clear briefs for designers and video editors, and develop outlines and facilitator materials for workshops, seminars, and other live formats.
Analyze each client’s learning needs, business goals, workflows, tools, operational constraints, and learner profiles together with Product Managers and client stakeholders.
Customize learning activities, case studies, learning paths, curriculum structure, and schedules to reflect authentic client tasks and the needs of different roles.
Continuously improve the learning experience by auditing cognitive load, motivation, difficulty, and alignment with learning outcomes; use learner feedback and expert recommendations to update content and maintain an improvement backlog.

At least three years of experience as an Instructional Designer, Learning Experience Designer, Learning Content Developer, Program Designer, or in a comparable role.
Proven experience applying modern learning experience design models, methodologies, and frameworks to the development of complex skills.
Experience structuring end-to-end learning experiences, including building Skill Trees and Learning Journey Maps and mapping learning outcomes.
Ability to create different forms of educational content, including long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, and other learning aids.
Experience designing and integrating skills and knowledge assessments into a course.
English proficiency at C1 level (strong B2 users with a good fit in other requirements are welcome to apply, too).

Strong familiarity with popular AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design). Experience creating your own agents or workflows, or some familiarity with coding, is a strong plus.
Experience adapting curricula for B2B clients based on their business goals, workflows, learner profiles, and operational constraints.
What we can offer you
Remote, full-time collaboration.
Performance appraisals twice a year and a bonus system.
Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth.
Have the freedom to work professionally. We trust your experience and don't believe in micromanaging.
Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself.
Diverse and close-knit team. We're spread out across the world: Europe, Asia and Latin America.

Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services.

This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care.

Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

As an Instructional Designer on Ro’s Care Delivery team, you will design and develop scalable learning experiences for our frontline patient care teams, including the clinical and operational teams that deliver and support care.

You will partner closely with Clinical, Operations, Product, Quality & Safety, and other subject matter experts to translate complex and evolving information into clear, practical learning that equips our teams with the knowledge and skills they need to deliver high-quality care at scale.
You will support learning across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and ongoing development to new clinical programs, product launches, updated guidelines, systems, policies, and workflows. You will determine the right learning approach for each team (both clinical and non-clinical) and deliver scalable training that emphasizes practical application, decision-making, and performance on the job.
You are an experienced instructional designer who is comfortable working with clinical and technical complexity. You identify what learners truly need to know and do and turn that information into effective, engaging learning experiences. You bring strong attention to detail, sound instructional judgment, and a hands-on, solutions-oriented approach to working in a fast-moving environment.

Design & develop learning | Own instructional design projects end-to-end, creating engaging, asynchronous-first learning.
Build for scale | Coordinate across teams to identify shared learning needs and build modular content that can be scaled across roles and audiences, while tailoring learning where workflows, responsibilities, or clinical scope differ.
Translate complexity | Partner with Clinical, Operations, Product, Quality & Safety, and other SMEs to turn complex and evolving information into clear, practical learning for frontline teams.
Enable continuous learning | Create and maintain learning materials that effectively support onboarding, ongoing development, and changes to programs, products, systems, and workflows.
5+ years of experience in a clinical / healthcare training role.

Strong instructional design expertise, including adult learning principles, needs analysis, measurable learning objectives, application-based learning, and assessment design.
Proven ability to translate complex clinical, technical, and operational information into clear, practical learning experiences.
Experience partnering with clinical subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders to develop accurate, effective learning solutions.
Hands-on experience developing across learning modalities and technologies, including eLearning tools such as Articulate 360 (Rise and Storyline); experience with LMS platforms and learning analytics is a plus.
A high sense of ownership, strong attention to detail, and comfort managing multiple projects and evolving priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

s.h: The Role: Design the Learning. Set the Standard. Take the Stage.
s.t:
We're looking for a Senior Instructional Designer to join the team that shapes how Synthesia teaches the world to use Synthesia. This is Customer Education, not in-house enablement.
You'll be joining a team of instructional designers who collectively own the part of the pipeline where quality is actually decided: needs analysis and learning design .

You'll carry your own portfolio of work end-to-end — figuring out what learners genuinely need, deciding what to build (and what not to), and producing design blueprints sharp enough that our Knowledge & Enablement Specialists can develop and publish them without needing to guess.

You'll stay close to the build, getting hands-on in development where it counts, but your leverage comes from the thinking that happens before anyone opens a timeline.
You’ll be joining a team of ambitious instructional designers who will be your deep collaborators, sounding board and discussion partners. We work hard to avoid silos - collaboration is highly valued and built into out structure.
This role is also the face and voice of our learning content . You'll facilitate live sessions and workshops for customers, and you'll represent Synthesia on stage at some of the biggest L&D, and AI conferences in North America. If you're happiest designing quietly in a doc and never speaking to a room, this isn't the role.
And a word on AI, because we mean something specific by it: we are AI first but we loath AI slop. We've built a purpose-built content production pipeline that AI accelerates — it doesn't replace the craft, the instructional rigour, or the review gates. We want someone who has gone well beyond typing a prompt into a chat window: someone who has built agentic workflows, broken them, measured them, and made them better.

1. Own Needs Analysis
Run the discovery that decides what we build: talk to customers, interrogate product usage and support data, work with Product, CS, and Support to find where learners are actually getting stuck.
Separate real learning needs from content requests. Say no to the ones that don't hold up, and make the case for the ones that do.
Define audiences, personas, prerequisites, and success measures before design begins.
Bring evidence, not vibes. Your recommendations should be defensible.
2. Own Learning Design
Design courses, certifications, learning paths, and live sessions grounded in strong instructional design principles.
Turn complex product concepts into clear, sequenced, outcome-driven learning experiences.
Produce the design artefacts the pipeline runs on: learning objectives, outlines, storyboards, assessment strategy, activation hypothosises and format decisions.
Make deliberate modality choices — video, in-LMS experience, live workshop — and be able to explain why.
Work in the open with your fellow designers: share drafts early, give and take critique properly, and help hold a consistent design standard across everything the team produces.
Contribute to the shared design system, templates, and ways of working, so the team gets faster and better together rather than each designer reinventing the approach.
3. Hand Off Cleanly — Then Get Your Hands Dirty
Hand off to Knowledge & Enablement Specialists with designs specified well enough to build from directly, and stay available as the design authority through development.
Hold the quality bar across everything that ships, whether or not you personally built it.
Get hands-on in development yourself: build, script, edit, and publish where it's the fastest path to something good.
Give clear, generous, specific feedback. Coach the team's craft, don't just approve their output.
4. Build and Iterate on AI-Accelerated Workflows
Design and refine the AI workflows that power our production pipeline — multi-step, agentic, tool-using systems, not one-shot prompts.
Treat your workflows like a product: version them, evaluate their output, find where they break, and improve them.
Know exactly where AI belongs in the pipeline and where a human has to stay in the loop. Defend that line.
Bring the rest of the team along, so good AI practice becomes how we work rather than a thing you do alone.
5. Facilitate and Represent
Facilitate live customer sessions, workshops, and webinars — with real energy, not read-aloud slides.
Speak at major North American conferences as a credible voice on instructional design in the age of AI.
Develop and deliver talks, demos, and workshops that people remember and act on.
Bring what you hear on stage and in rooms back into the roadmap.
6. Measure and Improve
Use engagement, completion, assessment, and qualitative product data to judge whether learning actually worked.
Retire and rebuild content that isn't earning its place.
Treat the whole content catalogue as a living product.

A senior instructional designer with real depth in needs analysis and design, and a portfolio that proves it.
Someone who thinks in systems and pipelines , not just individual assets.
A strong peer — you're at your best in a team of good designers, you share work before it's finished, and you take critique as a gift rather than a threat.
A confident facilitator and public speaker , online and in person, who genuinely enjoys a room and a stage.
Fluent with AI beyond prompting — you've built agentic or multi-step workflows and iterated on them with real rigour.

In an AI-native environment, the product shifts fast, new workflows emerge weekly, and customers and internal teams surface needs in real time. Someone has to meet those needs at the speed they arise. That's this role.
As a lead learning experience designer, you'll own a fast-paced, high-volume learning design track focused on short, targeted, just-in-time courses — typically 15–45 minutes each, built in sprints of three weeks or less, shipping roughly 15+ courses per year. You'll build focused one-off courses that plug specific gaps: a new workflow, a role-specific skill, a tool that just shipped, an AI topic that can't wait for the next curriculum cycle.
These courses are standalone, purpose-built, and often shorter-lived — responding to the moment. You'll work both proactively (scanning for emerging needs) and reactively (fielding requests from across the company and from customers). The pace is fast, the iteration cycles are tight, and the environment is dynamic. If you're energized by change, comfortable shipping at speed, and able to balance strategic proactivity with rapid reactive response, this is your role.
In addition, you'll deliver live and virtual trainings on these topics as needed — bringing the same speed and adaptability from your on-demand work into the live environment, whether in person or on a webinar platform.
The primary medium for this role is video-based learning. You'll be the voice and face of your own instruction — recording voiceover or appearing on camera to teach software and AI topics, combined with screencaptures, screen recordings, and graphics. This is not a role where you'll hand off to a video team or rely on AI-generated voice. You are the teacher, and your voice is part of the craft.
This role complements our end-to-end learning experience designers, who own robust, polished curricula built over longer timelines. You're not integrated within those larger curriculum builds; you're filling the space they can't reach.

Your courses are shorter, faster, and more targeted, designed to serve a specific need and plug a gap where the larger curriculum moves too slowly. Think of it as the agile track of the LXD team: smaller scope, faster cadence, and a bias toward shipping. You won't be building three- to four-hour flagship programs.

You'll be building tight, high-impact courses that get someone up to speed on a specific thing, quickly, and then moving on to the next one.
